(HCCI), 256 West 153rd Street, Ground Floor, New York, New York 10039 (the “Victory Plaza HDFC") as record legal owner of Developer Parcel (hereafter defined) and Victory Plaza Owner LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 32 East 31st Street, 9th Floor, New York, New York 10016 as beneficial owner of the Developer Parcel (together with the Victory Plaza HDFC, individually and collectively, the “Developer"); (the Owner and Developer, collectively, the “Parties” and individually, a“Party"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of New York, known as Lot 33 in Block 1717 on the Tax Map of the City of New York(the “Tax Map"),and as and by the street address 1460 5th Avenue,New York,New York,and more particularly described in Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the buildings and improvements located thereon, and any replacements or Rebuilding (hereafter defined) thereof is herein referred to as the“Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the“Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of New York, known as Lot 28 in Block 1717 on the Tax Map, and as and by the street address 11 West 118th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer Land"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new building or buildings on the Developer Land and/or any Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined), and construct other improvements associated with such new buildings (the new building(s) and improvements together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or Rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building"; and the Developer Land and the Developer Building are herein WHEREAS,the Owner Land and the Developer Land are located on a single Zoning lot (such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged or subdivided in accordance with the terms of this Agreement, is herein referred to as the“Merged Zoning Lot")pursuant to that certain Zoning Lot Description and Ownership Statement made by Owner, dated October 8, 2018 and recorded October 12, 2018 at CRFN 2018000340434 (herein referred to as the “ZLDOS");
